subject: Re: CKD kickoff — hallucination-resistant captioning via contrastive distillation
body:
Lucia,

Sizing done, here's the plan.

The long pole is exactly what you suspected. We're scoping and staffing a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch — negative-object mining over the image corpora plus cached model-generated descriptions — since nothing reusable exists in the org for this. Concretely: stage 1 mines plausible negative objects per image (the vg_sample_negatives path), stage 2 generates and caches descriptions from our strongest internal model so training never blocks on inference. Wanjiru and Chiara own it, both at 50% for six weeks starting next week.

Rest of staffing: Wei 40% (distillation objective + training), Fumiko 40% (POPE eval harness + analysis).

Compute: pipeline is inference-heavy, ~20 A100s sustained on Titan through June. Distillation runs in July need ~64 A100s; still best-effort class, no reservation.

Ivo
